lines.text: Messi or Ronaldo? Let's settle it with trophies only. No feelings.
Ballon d'Or. Messi has eight. Ronaldo has five. Point, Messi.
Champions League. Ronaldo has five. Messi has four. Point, Ronaldo.
World Cup. Messi lifted it in 2022. Ronaldo never has. Point, Messi.
International goals. Ronaldo is the all-time top scorer in men's international football. Point, Ronaldo.
That's two all. So it comes down to you.
Messi or Ronaldo? Drop your pick in the comments, and follow for round two!
